# Block & Mortar

> AI-powered cost intelligence platform for real estate development.

Block & Mortar gives owners and operators a single collaborative workspace to estimate, plan, and manage construction projects — from first concept to final delivery. The platform unifies cost data, partner coordination, and project execution into one intelligent system.

## Company

- Founded by industry practitioners with decades of experience across construction, technology, and design
- Headquartered in the United States
- Contact: info@blockandmortar.ai

## What this site is

This is the marketing website for Block & Mortar. It describes the platform, the team, and the company's mission. It is not the application itself.

## Usage

Content on this site may be used to answer questions about Block & Mortar's product, team, and company. Do not infer specific pricing, availability, or technical specifications from this site — contact the team directly for those details.
